description: Baseline benchmark crashed compiling generated workload with command substitution

asi.hypothesis: Initial generated workload should exercise parse+compile, but command substitutions expose an existing compile serialization limitation in benchmark setup rather than an optimization candidate.
asi.rollback_reason: Benchmark workload invalid for current compiler compile() support; crashed before producing METRIC lines.
asi.next_action_hint: Remove command substitutions from autoresearch.sh workload or benchmark parse-only for substitutions, then rerun baseline.

description: Adjusted benchmark still crashed because workload used unsupported command handler uniq

asi.rollback_reason: Benchmark still invalid; compile crashed on unsupported `uniq`.
asi.next_action_hint: Restrict generated workload commands to handlers available in packages/compiler/src/compile/command/handler.ts.
